closure.interpretation: Riabouchinsky physical sharp disk plus a symmetric artificial image disk. Unknown L is their full separation, not a predicted natural tail.

referenceRule: Rm(L/Rn) = 1 + 0.4*sqrt(L/Rn); numerical reference coordinates only, not an empirical cavity fit.

search.referenceRule: Rm(L/Rn) = 1 + 0.4*sqrt(L/Rn); numerical reference coordinates only, not an empirical cavity fit.

final.method: C1 Hermite meridian in graded tau, C2 spline sheet, weighted least-squares Gauss collocation

curve.method: Polynomial extrema over every cubic/quintic panel; no finite sampling used for admission.

final.accuracyStatus: Research result: nodal -gamma is the reconstructed trace; the direct exterior field is audited separately. No experimental validation.

profile.interpretation: Actual solved curved BEM panels. Rear half is the symmetric artificial-image continuation.

drag.interpretation: Front physical disk only; no cylinder afterbody drag.

volume.interpretation: Full disk-to-image envelope volume of the Riabouchinsky model; not a measured or naturally closing vapor-cavity volume.

body.interpretation: Exact radial extrema of the solved C1 polynomial panels over the specified cylinder length. Geometric containment inside an artificial-image envelope only; wetted cylinder flow, body drag, reattachment and ventilation are not solved.
